parole.significato: Fructidor (the twelfth month of the French Republican Calendar)
parole.testo: From frutto (“fruit”) + Ancient Greek δῶρον (dôron, “gift”), calque of French fructidor.

parole.significato: Messidor (the tenth month of the French Republican Calendar)
parole.testo: From messe (“harvest”) + Ancient Greek δῶρον (dôron, “gift”), calque of French messidor.

parole.significato: Thermidor (the eleventh month of the French Republican Calendar)
parole.testo: From Ancient Greek θέρμη (thérmē, “heat”) + δῶρον (dôron, “gift”), as a calque of French thermidor.
